_comment: Readiness means different things per field. When a column is focused, its axis relabels to this language. Definitions are the thing to argue with — they must survive being defended.

levels.emerging: Proposed in literature or preprint. No independent replication.
levels.experimental: Replicated in at least one independent lab. Not at useful scale.
levels.demonstrated: Working at meaningful scale, or a standard formally published.
levels.adopted: Shipping in named products, or on a published migration roadmap.
levels.mainstream: Default in mainstream deployment; absence is now the exception.

levels.emerging: Described in research. No observed use.
levels.experimental: Proof of concept, or isolated observed use.
levels.demonstrated: Repeatedly observed in the wild, or formally standardised.
levels.adopted: Widely deployed in defensive or offensive practice.
levels.mainstream: Assumed baseline; its absence is the finding.

levels.emerging: Claimed in a paper or preprint. Not independently reproduced.
levels.experimental: Reproduced externally. Benchmark-only, not in products.
levels.demonstrated: Working in a shipped product at limited scale.
levels.adopted: In general availability across multiple providers.
